title: 4 Tromso (Oslo pre/post), winter

services.description: Private Transfer from Tromso Airport to Hotel
Tromsø Island Tour with Arctic Cathedral
Night Reindeer Sledding Tour with Dinner (18h00-22h30)
Private Transfer from Hotel to Tromso Airport

day_descriptions.Day 1: Arrive in Tromsø, the 'Paris of the North'. After checking in, embark on an evening cruise in search of the elusive Northern Lights, far from the city's light pollution.
day_descriptions.Day 2: Discover Tromsø Island on a guided tour, featuring the stunning Arctic Cathedral. Later, enjoy a night of Sami culture and reindeer sledding under the starlit sky.
day_descriptions.Day 3: An adrenaline-filled day as you head out on a snowmobile safari through the frozen wilderness. Experience the silence and scale of the Arctic landscape.
day_descriptions.Day 4: Set sail on a whale-watching tour to witness the ocean's giants in their natural habitat. In the evening, relax in one of Tromsø's cozy Arctic bars.
day_descriptions.Day 5: Enjoy a final Arctic morning before your private transfer to the airport for your flight home.

top_experiences: Chasing the Northern Lights by cruise
unique_highlights: Stay deep within the Arctic Circle during the magical winter season
Multiple chances to witness the Aurora Borealis
Iconic landmarks like the Arctic Cathedral
